unit_or_scope: US public libraries and library buildings
direct_observation: About 6000 libraries nearly 40 percent reported part of a building in poor condition and about 7000 reported a physical barrier for disabled people; federal funding generally supports programs/services rather than construction/repairs
closed_stage: facility condition accessibility and capital boundary
missing_stage: repair staffing hours technology service use and civic/cultural outcome
evidence_status: official GAO survey and interviews; national aggregate
next_test: trace named library condition funding repair accessibility and use

direct_observation: GAO estimates 55 percent of rural libraries have at least one accessibility barrier versus 33 percent of urban libraries; 24 percent of rural libraries lack an accessible or sufficiently accessible entrance versus 5 percent urban
missing_stage: individual entry accommodation service use trust and participation
next_test: follow named library accessibility correction and disabled user experience

unit_or_scope: US public library institutions resources and use
direct_observation: IMLS provides survey data files and service measures covering library institutions resources and use
missing_stage: local funding staffing hours service quality user purpose and outcome
next_test: build place-level service and condition panel

unit_or_scope: state and territory public libraries FY2018-FY2021
direct_observation: Outside Wi-Fi was a popular way libraries met digital needs especially in rural and town libraries; analysis tracks finances resources staffing services and usage
missing_stage: durable access quality repeat use learning benefit access belonging and trust
next_test: compare rural and urban Wi-Fi/service use with household outcome evidence

unit_or_scope: rural federally assisted housing and service coordination
direct_observation: Stakeholders reported limited reliable broadband and cell service constrain virtual coordination and telehealth; digital transitions can leave residents without skills unable to access benefits
missing_stage: library-mediated service completion benefit health outcome and institutional trust
evidence_status: official GAO stakeholder evidence; library contribution not identified
next_test: identify named library service route and same-user completion/outcome

unit_or_scope: Kansas City Public Library mentor and 13 small or rural participant libraries
direct_observation: Two cohorts used in-person meetings virtual sessions a shared portal and one-to-one coaching; evaluation found evidence of improved digital-inclusion capacity and stronger library-community connections while cohorts differed
closed_stage: named peer-learning and institutional capacity route
missing_stage: patron device access service completion repeat use and downstream work benefit health or civic outcome
evidence_status: official IMLS evaluation; capacity and program evidence not patron longitudinal outcome
next_test: match participant-library changes to local program delivery patrons and repeat outcomes

source_title: Public Library Association Columbus digital navigators
unit_or_scope: Columbus Metropolitan Library 23 outlets and adult-services staff
direct_observation: Staff training and a dedicated Community Support Center emphasize safe nonjudgmental help and assess a patron goal barriers and unexpressed needs
closed_stage: named digital-navigation service encounter and relational quality
missing_stage: representative repeat use problem resolution privacy accessibility and downstream outcome
evidence_status: professional survey case; reported practice not independent outcome evaluation
next_test: follow patron goal appointment resolution repeat use and work health benefit or civic completion

source_title: ALA Hartford Public Library community engagement
unit_or_scope: Hartford Public Library North End underserved neighborhood
direct_observation: Library staff used community-engagement training to reach disengaged residents improve relationships with institutions and act as a trusted convener
closed_stage: named civic-cultural relationship and voice route
missing_stage: participants institutional decisions trust persistence conflict and policy outcome
evidence_status: ALA case account; reported initiative and role not causal evaluation
next_test: trace residents meeting participation institutional response and repeat local trust

source_title: ALA Jarrell Community Library and Resource Center
unit_or_scope: Jarrell Texas growing service area and groups with disability care and military needs
direct_observation: Community-led programming is reported as transforming a small library from a building of books into a community center serving neurodivergent families dementia caregivers older adults with sensory disabilities and military families
closed_stage: named community-led space and locally specific inclusion
missing_stage: staffing accessibility repeat participation service quality safety and group-specific outcomes
evidence_status: ALA case account; qualitative reported practice not representative outcome
next_test: match group needs to programs access accommodations repeat use and belonging

source_title: IMLS Bangor Public Library workforce case
unit_or_scope: Bangor Public Library Maine co-working space
direct_observation: A co-working space opened in 2021 in response to identified community needs but use was lower than anticipated; staff developed referral networks and partnerships
closed_stage: explicit underuse counterexample and adaptive referral response
missing_stage: actual demand fit repeat use workforce outcomes cost and local economic impact
evidence_status: official IMLS case study; qualitative/program account
next_test: compare intended users occupancy repeat use referral completion and work outcomes
